translations.web: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off, and went their way.
translations.bsb: They had taken captive the women and all who were there, both young and old. They had not killed anyone, but had carried them off as they went on their way.
translations.kjv: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
translations.asv: and had taken captive the women and all that were therein, both small and great: they slew not any, but carried them off, and went their way.
